main_body: A small wooden chair seen from the front: a slatted backrest on top (rows 2-7), a seat (rows 8-10), then legs with a dark gap between them (rows 11-14).
top_band: Column x=8: the topmost light rows 3-6 alternate #d59147 and #b77246 and are the backrest slats, which are vertical. The seat at rows 8-10 is mid tone #9e684b/#b77246 with one light row at row 10. There is no distinct lighter horizontal band.
evidence: Rows 3-6 are the backrest slats, a vertical face, so they are not a top. The seat is only about 2-3 rows tall and has the same L (~124-130) as the backrest and front tones, so it reads as a thin front-facing band, like the guide's red 'thin seat'. The seat surface is not clearly seen from above. A dark row at row 11 sits under the seat, but there is no distinct lighter top surface, front-edge line or recess. The whole drawing reads as a chair in front elevation.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 7 distinct colours and a median of 7 colours per tile, against 38-40 distinct colours and 17-20 per tile in the references. The wood ramp has about 3 steps (light, mid, dark) plus black. 63% of the dark edge pixels are neutral, and there are pure #000000 pixels under the seat and at the bottom, which gives a black-sticker look rather than a dark wood tone. There is no grain or texture. The 5x5 flat-fill coverage is 0% only because the piece is tiny. It is much thinner than the references.
